title: [Koyu] Lesson Report – Full-access staff – Active score layout – Editing allowed
description: AC 2.1.1 — Permission Matrix — Full-access staff can edit the active score fields.
preconditions: - A full-access staff member is logged in to the Koyu Salesforce organization.\n- The SF Lesson Custom Setting is ON.\n- Student A's Lesson Report Detail is editable.
steps_actions: 1. The full-access staff member opens Student A's Lesson Report.\n2. The full-access staff member enters Total Score 20.0 and saves the report.
steps_result: 1. Total Score and Test Result are visible and editable.\n2. The save completes and Total Score displays 20.0.

title: [Koyu] Learner App – Student – Active score layout – Editing unavailable
description: AC 2.1.2 — Permission Matrix / Negative — A student can read but cannot edit active score fields.
preconditions:
- Student A is logged in to the Koyu Learner App.
- The App internal score setting is ON.
- Student A's lesson and Lesson Report are published.
- Student A's Total Score is 20.0.
- Student A's Test Result is 18.5.
steps_actions: 1. Student A opens the published Lesson Report.\n2. Student A selects the score area.
steps_result: 1. Total Score 20.0 and Test Result 18.5 display read-only.\n2. No editable field, Save action, or score modification control is available.

title: [Koyu] Lesson Report – Koyu configuration – Other organization – New score layout not exposed
description: Scope — Permission Matrix / Regression — The Koyu-specific score layout does not leak to another organization.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to a non-Koyu organization.\n- The Koyu SF Lesson Custom Setting is ON only for Koyu.\n- A comparable Lesson Report exists in the non-Koyu organization.
steps_actions: 1. HQ or CM Staff opens the comparable Lesson Report in the non-Koyu organization.\n2. HQ or CM Staff opens the same type of Lesson Report in Koyu.
steps_result: 1. The Koyu-only Total Score and Test Result layout does not appear.\n2. The Koyu active layout follows Koyu's own configuration without affecting the non-Koyu organization.
steps_data: 1. organization = non-Koyu; koyu_setting = ON\n2. organization = Koyu
